items.statement: Both explicitly defined diastereomers are investigated with documented conformer generation, duplicate removal and stability/minimum validation before property averaging.
items.expected: Submission identifies both candidates, reports conformer coverage and deduplication, and gives a stability/minimum validation record for each.

items.statement: Calculated NMR shifts are atom-matched to the experimental C2-C12 carbons and H7-H12 protons and compared using explicit fit statistics.
items.expected: Submission states atom matching and reports carbon and proton fit statistics for each candidate.

items.statement: The SI DP4+ combined-data analysis assigns 9.55% to isomer 1 and 90.45% to isomer 2.
The paper reports the favored candidate’s regression/error metrics as R2 0.9985/0.9915, CMAD 1.74/0.08, LAD 4.68/0.15 and RMSD 2.60/0.10 for 13C/1H.
items.expected: Submission reports these values or transparently explains a bounded computational deviation.
